support.quote: Open in Spirit stance with Cyclebreaker to take less damage and stun the closest enemy, then switch stance and use Force Push to shove divers off your carry. Once Stonewall and Forticus land, stand in front and soak hits for your team.
support.issue: Cyclebreaker throws the staff forward, it does not stun the closest enemy; "divers" is jargon
support.rewrite: Open in Spirit stance with Cyclebreaker to take less damage, then throw the staff to stun the enemy in front of you; switch stance and use Force Push to shove attackers off your carry. Once Stonewall and Forticus land, stand in front and soak hits for your team.
